title: Jensen Huang's downfall exposes Nvidia's internal politics; source: Huang ran Nvidia as a "feudal system" with his daughter and son-in-law in powerful positions (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: Jensen Huang's downfall exposes Nvidia's internal politics; source: Huang ran Nvidia as a “feudal system” with his daughter and son-in-law in powerful positions — After 33 years building Nvidia into the world's most valuable company, its founder's career disintegrated in less than two weeks
